page.layout: Full-width title block at top centre: show-through of the reverse title lines (mirrored, not transcribed); the main heading "Imprimatur." in large type; below, two columns side by side: left column the place and date of the imprimatur, right column the licenser's name and office. A digitiser's mark at lower right and a library stamp are not transcribed.

main_text.head: Imprimatur.
main_text.p: Guil. Needham RR. in Christo P. ac D. D. Wilhelmo Archiep. Cant. à Sacris Domesticis.

page.notes: The show-through lines of the reverse (mirrored title text, "JACOBI USSERII ARMACHANI HISTORIA DOGMATICA DE SCRIPTURA ... SACRIS VERNACULIS") are not printed on this side and are left out. The ex-libris stamp and digitiser watermark are omitted. The line "Ex Ædibus Lambhithanis" is read as printed, with "Lambhithanis" as the printer set it.
